people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

translations.web: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”
translations.bsb: but Esau I have hated, and I have made his mountains a wasteland and left his inheritance to the desert jackals.”
translations.kjv: And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.
translations.asv: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.
